[list][list][pre]| June of 2026, The 9th Day, Tuesday // Serceniza, Ascoi Province |[/pre][/list][/list]
(Beginning & Introduction Post before I go to work today)
[b][u]_______________________________________[/u][/b]

(Background Context, Section) [list] | The City of Serceniza, continued as it usually would for much of it's history the banners of the Imperial Dynasty still being slowly and gradually ripped and torn down by it's residents as the sun continued to shine through the scattered and incoherent clouded sky above, the streets bustling with activity and residents tending and toiling to errands of ordinary purpose and goals, since the end of the Dynasty the nation's gas reserves now dried the factories which one processed the crude gas into useable gasoline now repurposed to run on coal and steam as the once great roads which scattered across the nation lay rarely used beyond those of horseback-drawn carts, and the occasional bicycle. | [/list]

[list] | Deeper within the city itself a dormant radio tower began to come to life, blaring a signal and an unfamiliar language should those overhear it's broadcast | [/list]

[spoiler= Unidentified Radio Transmission]
[list][list] [i]" Andoi ta obarvat?, neidoi obvar una sasunt var?"[/i] [/list][/list]

[list] | The Line ended and another voice came through, speaking a basic understandable language | [/list]

[list][list] [i]" Today is... June of Twenty-Sixth Year of the Two-Thousandth Millennium, the Temperature is... Seventeen Ka- Celsius in bright and sunny Serceniza, The President... Antusidan-Zeten Quateni of the newly formed- Third Federal Republic declared in a public gathering within Ascoi, Sercenzia of the initiative to re-industrialize the nation after the fall and collapse of the Imperial Dynasty, Efforts are being made to reconnect the districts of; Yateni, Zentan, Ovua and Duven on the mainland far from the coast.. that is all from us, the Zetenvian National Radio Broadcast.. "[/i] [/list][/list]

[list][list] [i]" We will, redeclare the transmission whenever possible as soon as Power is fully restored, to the nation at large, Zeten'Ian, Zeten'karventi, Zetenvians Kurat. "[/i] [/list][/list]

[list] | The Transmission would continue and seemingly repeat as music were to be placed, the quality subpar but clearly music. | [/list]
[/spoiler]

(Alright, this is my one post for the day, I'm going to back to job hunting & Work on my factbooks)
